title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)

# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv')

# 2. Build the exact HTML image tag manually
# This avoids the kableExtra 'image' argument which is causing the brackets
image_tags <- paste0("<img src='[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/)", 
                     trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo), 
                     "/main/Capture.PNG' width='200'>")

# 3. Build Demo and Repo links
repo_only <- gsub(".*\\/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo)
viz_links <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", trimws(repo_only), "/")

# 4. Create the display data frame
display_df <- data.frame(
  Screenshot = image_tags,
  Project = paste0("<b>", dt$title, "</b>"),
  Links = paste0("<a href='", viz_links, "'>Interactive Demo</a><br>",
                  "<a href='", dt$source, "'>Source Code</a>")
)

# 5. Generate the table
# Note: escape = FALSE is the key here to let the <img> tags work
kable(display_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
